purpose: one bounded falsification of relation-coverage-guided acquisition, not repeated optimization to positive results

selection.cohort: exact previously consumed fair32; raw file and normalized tasks hashes have distinct definitions
selection.claim: regression/implementation diagnosis only; no independent test/generalization gain

shared.initial: identical BM25 Top20, complete first5, previews only in remaining capacity; pack against largest complete policy prompt
shared.terminal: byte-identical v1 common verifier; unique displayed citations or insufficient/conflicting abstention; no terminal tools

change: autonomous gate returns 1-3 exact claim spans, relation/time/quantity/scope, covered/partial/missing/uncertain, actual displayed sentence IDs, one existing action and explicit stop reason; no forced acquisition
falsifier: all-stop, irrelevant acquisition, no new full-text delivery to later physical prompts, or no quality support invalidates promotion; more calls/IDs alone never qualify

measurement.official: existing post-exit official task scoring; all32/arm, no failure dropping; prior original scores not overwritten
measurement.semantic: separate pinned automatic NLI citation-support proxy; not human labels or ground truth, no calibration on these32
measurement.behavior: proposal -> validated arguments -> execution -> delivery -> next physical prompt -> decision -> common verdict/citations
measurement.cost: all real gate/plan, tool/rerank, repair, verdict attempts, failures, tokens, loading, scoring, operator and GPU/storage fees
measurement.feedback_causality: whole policy comparison only; no pure feedback-causal claim
